purpose: Disambiguate live uses of the word support so exact compatibility, typed admissibility and heuristic evidence are never compared or merged as if they were the same quantity.
laws: SUPPORT KIND MUST BE EXPLICIT WHEN THE NUMBER OR boolean CAN AFFECT INTERPRETATION.
EXACT SET SUPPORT != TYPED TRANSITION SUPPORT != HEURISTIC CUE SUPPORT.
ZERO EXACT SUPPORT means no source identity satisfies the current exact constraints; preserve the contradiction.
ZERO TYPED TRANSITION SUPPORT means the candidate transition is not admissible under the current contract.
ZERO HEURISTIC CUE SUPPORT means the heuristic found no matching cues; manual choice remains lawful unless policy says otherwise.

EXACT_SET_CARDINALITY.meaning: Integer count of records that exactly survive a candidate value while all other selected dimensions remain fixed.
EXACT_SET_CARDINALITY.falsifiability: Recompute from the named source and selected dimensions; counts must match.

TYPED_TRANSITION_ADMISSIBILITY.meaning: Whether a candidate operation/lens may lawfully follow the current typed contract; may carry reasons and next contract.
TYPED_TRANSITION_ADMISSIBILITY.falsifiability: Validate candidate inputContract against the current output contract; result must match typed composition law.

HEURISTIC_CUE_EVIDENCE.meaning: Count/weight of textual or behavioral cues that suggest a candidate route; informative but not exact compatibility.
HEURISTIC_CUE_EVIDENCE.falsifiability: Re-run the declared cue grammar on the same text; count/score must reproduce, but semantic correctness remains empirical.

forbidden_conversions: Do not convert heuristic cue counts into exact survivor counts.
Do not interpret typed transition support as probability or confidence.
Do not rank exact Constraint Surface values merely because their support count is larger.
Do not make support authorize OPEN, COMMIT, SEND or WORLD actuation.
next: If a fourth support-like mechanism appears, classify it here before reusing UI vocabulary or shared code.
